name: cse
description: Cascade Spec Engine — the full CSE toolset as one versioned Claude Code plugin. Bundles all 70 Cascade skills (spec, receive, delegate, research, strategy, legal, economics, analyze, ingest, scout, link, reeval, resurface, weekly, weekly-review, and more), the cascade-api MCP server (vendored, self-contained), and the capture hooks (decision/knowledge/work, vendored). Self-contained for marketplace install. Every command is colon-namespaced as /cse:<name>.
